note: Debut-volume manga (no light novels) from August and September 2026 that the August 1 picks did not cover, ranked against both collections. Links go to Barnes & Noble.

items.why: Shuzo Oshimi (Blood on the Tracks, The Flowers of Evil) doing a brother's-diagnosis family drama. The closest new book to the Look Back and Summer Hikaru Died register.
Yoiko Fujimi's story of a mixed-race woman in Japan topped a 2026 manga ranking there. Grounded, adult, and the most talked-about debut of the window.

items.t: And Then There Were None, Vol. 1
items.why: Aya Nikaido adapts the Agatha Christie novel. Squarely in Cat's historical mystery and literary adaptation lane, next to her Manga Classics.

items.meta: Aug 11 · VIZ Originals · sapphic sci-fi noir
items.why: A damaged detective and her cybernetic cat hunt killer angels. Noir action for you, GL for Cat, and an original VIZ series rather than a license.
Tasuku Karasuma (No Guns Life) in a Wild West where Lincoln survived. The series already ended in Japan, so it is a contained commitment.
A zombie outbreak in a shopping mall, told through the survivors' accounts. The horror debut of the window.
A low-level yakuza hides out as a Buddhist monk after a hitman wipes out his clan. Crime action with a comedic hook.
Ao Tajima's hotel that caters to hired killers. Stylish contract-killer action with an anime already behind it.
A girls' band comedy in the same space as Bocchi the Rock!, which you already shelve.

items.t: Three Days of Happiness: The Complete Omnibus
items.why: A man sells most of his remaining life for money and spends what is left. The whole story in one book.

items.t: Yuri Yuri Panic: A Case of Extreme Cuteness Has Occurred!, Vol. 1
items.why: A popular girl proposes to a plain introvert. Light GL comedy for Cat.

items.t: Can You Kiss Me First? Vol. 1
items.why: Yamayade's yuri romance. Another one for Cat's GL shelf.

items.t: The Demon Consort: "I Love You" Are Frightening Words, Vol. 1
items.why: A curse-murder mystery with a consort at the center. Worth a look for Cat if she wants more in the Apothecary Diaries vein.
The newest from Kozue Amano (Aria). Quiet and pretty, a slow read rather than a hook.
A cheap apartment comes with a ghost Shiba Inu. Short, gentle comedy.

items.t: Give Me a Hug, Mr. Frog!, Vol. 1
items.why: A student council president falls for whoever is inside the frog mascot. Fits your romcom lane without standing out.
Couple romcom built on one joke. Fine if the art lands for you.
Wolf and bunny girls against man-eating rabbits. Pulpy, but in your action-horror space.
Cells at Work set inside a cat. A spinoff for fans of the franchise.
Adaptation of the web animation. Only if you follow the show.

items.t: Mobile Suit Gundam the Witch from Mercury: Vanadis Heart, Vol. 1
items.why: Set after the anime finale. For Gundam fans only.

items.t: The Blood-Crawling Princess of a Ruined Country, Vol. 1
items.meta: Aug 25 · Yen Press · revenge dark fantasy
items.why: Enslaved princess revenge story. Familiar setup.
An orphan takes a shady offer of magic. Standard fantasy launch.
Cat-owner gag manga. Cute, slight.

items.t: My Useless "Cuddle" Skill Awakened, and Now I'm Building the Ultimate Harem! Vol. 1
items.why: Isekai harem with a one-line premise. Outside the lane you read.

items.t: Uesugi-kun Wants to Quit Being a Girl Vol. 1
items.why: Shrine curse gender swap. Not your usual lane.
